name: Risk Distribution to Funded Economic Decisions
authority: docs/OWNER_SPEC.md OWNER v2.0 with OWNER decision after MVE1 PR311-312 dated 2026-11-15
frozenAfter: MVE1 original verdict; no MVE1 forecasts, features, event tags, outcomes, or model coefficients feed RDE1
immutability: Original RDE1 protocol must be committed before first RDE1 outcome; subsequent bugfix only as separately documented prospective A1 or corrective diagnostic, never revised candidate selection.

observations.clock: each UTC hourly completed M5 close with exact prior 97 contiguous completed M5 candles
observations.nextEntryProxy: close of next fully completed M5 bar; never assume a broker fill
observations.forwardOutcome: from entry to fixed 24 M5 completed bars (120 minutes); require every forward M5 bar and phase-contained maturity
observations.sampleCensoring: record all predecision intents, later unknown forward path never suppresses original candidate
observations.directionStream: simple 48-M5 drift sign only if absolute 48-bar log return exceeds 0.75 times last48 return RMS times sqrt(48), last24-bar log return agrees in sign, else ABSTAIN; not an MVE1 event or trained MVE1 direction
observations.OHLCBounds: future high/low are path extremes, not executable stops or known intrabar sequence
observations.temporalLeakage: features available at t only; entry/exit realized prices labeled after decisions and maturity

distribution.target: 0.90-quantile of adverse price excursion bps conditional on entry at t+5m and hold 120m
distribution.simpleComparator: TRAIN-only global direction-specific empirical 90th quantile in units of causal past24 RMS * sqrt(24); no regime bins
distribution.conditionalModel: TRAIN-only quantile grouped by 3 volatility-terciles x 2 persistence states x direction; pooled shrinkage of 50 pseudo observations from the training global empirical CDF; train-only terciles, no symbol-specific optimization
distribution.forecasting: fixed estimated tail distribution, not confidence interval for conditional mean
evaluation: empirical future-tail exceedance coverage and calibration by time blocks
weekly paired quantile-score change vs simple predictor
distribution.statistics: 13 contiguous calendar-week paired means, 12 instruments averaged within each week; dependence on overlapping horizons is clustered by week, not bars; report raw mean and familywise Bonferroni 95%-lower bound for risk score and net; report no independent confirmation; zero-outcome weeks retained
distribution.multiplicity: two sides x three risk policies x 12 instruments (all published); no choosing favorable symbol/regime/time slice after results

economic.alphaPremise: Independent fixed 48-M5 24-M5 agreed drift signal only; risk forecast never creates or flips direction
economic.alphaGate: TRAIN26 only: require at least 16 causally non-overlapping completed reference round trips and at least 10 calendar weeks in each admitted instrument+direction, adverse-cost EUR 26-week block-mean lower bound >0 with Bonferroni 24; otherwise that instrument+direction abstains in all arms
economic.candidateClock: no signal and no train alpha => no entry, including no pseudo-trades for risk testing
economic.simpleRisk: reserve min legal units based on TRAIN-only simple 90%-tail estimate and a fixed per-position adverse-loss budget EUR15
economic.conditionalRisk: same EUR15 budget, same funding/cost terms and legal volume grid, substituting only trained conditional 90%-tail forecast
economic.fairComparator: same predecision directional intent, same EUR300 common capital, common concurrent marks, native ordering; all intent counts reported even when abstained
economic.preentryDecision: cost and potential adverse tail reserve in EUR and concurrent cash/free margin constrain native allocation, margin minimum+step preserved; do not round subminimum exposure up
economic.closeRule: fixed 120m or earlier mandated system 30%-DD protective invalidation; any earlier adverse risk intervention is accounted in all arms identically
economic.costs: reuse original synchronized train-dated native C# quote/commission/minmargin/FX context, with central/adverse/slippage and 3x directional current-term swap debit if crossing; missing execution, conversion, tariff or historical marks => UNKNOWN not zero
economic.accounting: existing native C# orchestrator and EUR300 ledger only; no Python second ledger or summing overlapping intents as PnL
economic.counterfactuals: matched full native portfolios, never claim isolated minimum-unit EUR sums are realizable
economic.riskCheck: max sampled adverse floating drawdown <=0.30, no unknown portfolio equity path allowed for qualification, no reset/cash injection, systemic HARD21 reported not forced

acceptance.riskInformation: 13-week paired 0.90 quantile score strictly improves simple risk comparator with Bonferroni-adjusted lower bound >0, acceptable calibration and no uncovered cost/data gaps
acceptance.economicInformation: conditional policy adverse NET EUR improves simple-risk policy and CASH and DOES NOT worsen maximum adverse floating DD, with fully financed native EUR300 book; report all three no-trade comparators and exact trade counts
acceptance.eligibility: selection pass alone preliminary; exposed periods only development and not independent, need truly new independent chronological material to qualify

implementationBoundary: Research-only; final cBot native C# cTrader Cloud on Android; read-only existing source if needed.
